# DeepSeek-V2: Efficient MoE Language Model with Multi-Head Latent Attention

## Source
https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.04434

## Model Overview

DeepSeek-V2 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 236B total parameters, of which only 21B are activated per token. It supports a 128K-token context length. The model was pretrained on 8.1T tokens from a high-quality, multi-source corpus with extended Chinese data. Post-training includes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on 1.5M conversational sessions and Reinforcement Learning via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).

Compared with DeepSeek 67B (a dense predecessor), DeepSeek-V2 delivers:
- **42.5% reduction** in training costs
- **93.3% reduction** in KV cache size
- **5.76× higher** maximum generation throughput

## Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA)

Conventional Multi-Head Attention (MHA) stores full key-value pairs per head per token, creating a KV cache bottleneck during autoregressive generation. Alternatives like Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Multi-Query Attention (MQA) reduce cache but sacrifice performance.

MLA introduces **low-rank key-value joint compression**: instead of caching full K and V vectors, MLA compresses them into a compact latent vector $\mathbf{c}_t^{KV}$, which is cached during inference. Full keys, values, and a decoupled RoPE-based positional key are reconstructed on-the-fly via learned projection matrices. This yields **better performance than MHA** while requiring dramatically less cache.

![Attention mechanism comparison: MHA vs GQA vs MQA vs MLA](./assets/figure_2.jpg)

## DeepSeekMoE Architecture

The FFN layers use the DeepSeekMoE design with two expert types:
- **Shared experts** ($N_s$): always activated, capture common knowledge
- **Routed experts** ($N_r$): sparsely activated via a top-$K_r$ router

Fine-grained expert segmentation increases specialization potential. Device-limited routing constrains each token to experts on at most $M$ devices, reducing cross-node communication. Auxiliary losses enforce load balance across experts and devices, and a token-dropping strategy during training prevents expert overflow without affecting inference.

![DeepSeek-V2 architecture diagram](./assets/figure_1.jpg)

## Performance Benchmarks

DeepSeek-V2 achieves top-tier MMLU performance among open-source models while activating far fewer parameters than competitors.

| Model | Activated Params (B) | MMLU Score |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V2 | 21 | 78.5 |
| LLaMA 3 70B | 70 | 77.0 |
| Mixtral 8x22B | 39 | 77.6 |
| Qwen1.5 72B | 72 | 75.6 |
| DeepSeek 67B | 67 | 73.0 |
| LLaMA 2 70B | 70 | 69.0 |
| Mixtral 8x7B | 13 | 70.6 |
| LLaMA 3 8B | 8 | 65.0 |

![MMLU vs activated parameters](./assets/figure_3.jpg)

## Alignment and Chat Evaluation

After SFT and GRPO-based RL, DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) achieves strong results on open-ended conversation benchmarks:

| Benchmark | DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) |
|---|---|
| AlpacaEval 2.0 (length-controlled win rate) | 38.9% |
| MT-Bench (overall) | 8.97 |
| AlignBench (overall, Chinese) | 7.91 |

On AlignBench (Chinese), DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) outperforms all open-source models and most closed-source models, demonstrating exceptional multilingual alignment quality.

## Key Findings

- **MLA achieves superior performance to MHA** while reducing KV cache by 93.3%, making it a strictly better alternative to GQA/MQA for inference efficiency.
- **DeepSeekMoE with fine-grained experts and shared expert isolation** enables training a 236B-parameter model at 42.5% lower cost than a 67B dense model.
- **Only 21B activated parameters** are needed to match or exceed 70B-class dense models (LLaMA 3 70B, Qwen1.5 72B) on MMLU.
- **5.76× throughput improvement** over DeepSeek 67B makes DeepSeek-V2 practical for large-scale deployment.
- **DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL) is the strongest open-source chat model in Chinese** and competitive with closed-source systems in English open-ended evaluation.---

python - <<'PY'
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.chart.data import XyChartData
from pptx.enum.chart import XL_CHART_TYPE

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

BG = RGBColor(245,247,250)
NAVY = RGBColor(15,23,42)
BLUE = RGBColor(30,64,175)
TEAL = RGBColor(13,148,136)
GRAY = RGBColor(71,85,105)
WHITE = RGBColor(255,255,255)


def set_bg(slide, color=BG):
    fill = slide.background.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_title(slide, title, subtitle=None):
    t = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.25), Inches(12.2), Inches(0.9))
    tf = t.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    r = p.add_run()
    r.text = title
    r.font.size = Pt(34)
    r.font.bold = True
    r.font.color.rgb = NAVY
    if subtitle:
        p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
        p2.text = subtitle
        p2.font.size = Pt(16)
        p2.font.color.rgb = GRAY


def add_bullets(slide, items, left=0.8, top=1.4, width=6.2, height=4.8, size=20):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(left), Inches(top), Inches(width), Inches(height))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = it
        p.level = 0
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = NAVY
        p.space_after = Pt(10)

# Slide 1
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "DeepSeek-V2: Efficient MoE Language Model with Multi-Head Latent Attention")
add_bullets(s, [
    "236B total parameters / 21B activated per token",
    "128K-token context length",
    "Pretrained on 8.1T tokens",
    "Source: DeepSeek-V2 (arXiv:2405.04434)"
], top=1.5, width=8.0, size=22)

# Slide 2
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "The LLM Scaling Dilemma: Performance vs. Cost and Latency")
add_bullets(s, [
    "Scaling dense LLMs improves capability but sharply increases training cost",
    "Autoregressive decoding is constrained by KV cache memory bandwidth",
    "GQA/MQA reduce cache pressure but can degrade quality",
    "Need: architecture that jointly improves quality, cost, and throughput"
], top=1.5, width=12.0, size=20)

# Slide 3
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "DeepSeek-V2 Architecture: MLA + DeepSeekMoE")
s.shapes.add_picture('/app/benchmark/assets/figure_1.jpg', Inches(1.1), Inches(1.3), width=Inches(11.2))

# Slide 4
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "MLA: Multi-Head Latent Attention")
add_bullets(s, [
    "Low-rank key-value joint compression caches compact latent vector c_t^KV",
    "Full K/V and decoupled RoPE positional key reconstructed on-the-fly",
    "Reduces inference-time KV cache while preserving attention expressivity",
    "Reported to outperform conventional MHA with much lower cache footprint"
], left=0.7, top=1.45, width=6.3, size=17)
s.shapes.add_picture('/app/benchmark/assets/figure_2.jpg', Inches(7.0), Inches(1.45), width=Inches(5.7))

# Slide 5
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "DeepSeekMoE: Fine-Grained Experts + Shared Isolation")
add_bullets(s, [
    "Shared experts (N_s): always active; capture common knowledge",
    "Routed experts (N_r): sparse top-K_r routing per token",
    "Fine-grained expert segmentation improves specialization",
    "Device-limited routing reduces cross-node communication",
    "Auxiliary losses + token dropping stabilize load balancing"
], top=1.45, width=12.0, size=18)

# Slide 6
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "Efficiency Gains vs. DeepSeek 67B")
# left box
l = s.shapes.add_shape(1, Inches(0.9), Inches(1.5), Inches(5.7), Inches(4.9))
l.fill.solid(); l.fill.fore_color.rgb = WHITE; l.line.color.rgb = RGBColor(203,213,225)
r = s.shapes.add_shape(1, Inches(6.8), Inches(1.5), Inches(5.7), Inches(4.9))
r.fill.solid(); r.fill.fore_color.rgb = RGBColor(239,246,255); r.line.color.rgb = BLUE
for x, txt, col in [(1.0,'DeepSeek 67B',GRAY),(6.9,'DeepSeek-V2',BLUE)]:
    tb=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(1.7), Inches(5.3), Inches(0.5)); tf=tb.text_frame; tf.text=txt; tf.paragraphs[0].font.size=Pt(22); tf.paragraphs[0].font.bold=True; tf.paragraphs[0].font.color.rgb=col
metrics=[("Training Cost","Baseline","42.5% lower"),("KV Cache Size","Baseline","93.3% lower"),("Max Generation Throughput","Baseline","5.76× higher")]
y=2.5
for m,b,v in metrics:
    for x,txt,col,bold in [(1.1,m,NAVY,True),(3.9,b,GRAY,False),(7.0,m,NAVY,True),(9.8,v,TEAL,True)]:
        tb=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(2.6), Inches(0.6)); tf=tb.text_frame; tf.text=txt; p=tf.paragraphs[0]; p.font.size=Pt(16); p.font.bold=bold; p.font.color.rgb=col
    y += 1.2

# Slide 7
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "MMLU vs. Activated Parameters: Pareto-Optimal Positioning")
chart_data = XyChartData()
series = chart_data.add_series('Models')
points=[('DeepSeek-V2',21,78.5),('LLaMA 3 70B',70,77.0),('Mixtral 8x22B',39,77.6),('Qwen1.5 72B',72,75.6),('DeepSeek 67B',67,73.0),('LLaMA 2 70B',70,69.0),('Mixtral 8x7B',13,70.6),('LLaMA 3 8B',8,65.0)]
for _,x,y in points: series.add_data_point(x,y)
chart = s.shapes.add_chart(XL_CHART_TYPE.XY_SCATTER, Inches(0.8), Inches(1.5), Inches(8.3), Inches(5.4), chart_data).chart
chart.has_legend = False
chart.category_axis.has_title = True
chart.category_axis.axis_title.text_frame.text = 'Activated Parameters (B)'
chart.value_axis.has_title = True
chart.value_axis.axis_title.text_frame.text = 'MMLU Score'
chart.value_axis.minimum_scale = 64
chart.value_axis.maximum_scale = 80
chart.category_axis.minimum_scale = 0
chart.category_axis.maximum_scale = 75
# side labels
tb=s.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(9.4), Inches(1.8), Inches(3.5), Inches(4.8)); tf=tb.text_frame; tf.clear()
for i,(n,x,y) in enumerate(points):
    p=tf.paragraphs[0] if i==0 else tf.add_paragraph(); p.text=f"{n}: ({x}B, {y})"; p.font.size=Pt(13); p.font.color.rgb = BLUE if n=='DeepSeek-V2' else NAVY

# Slide 8
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "Alignment Results: DeepSeek-V2 Chat (RL)")
add_bullets(s, [
    "Post-training: SFT on 1.5M conversational sessions + GRPO RL",
    "AlpacaEval 2.0 (length-controlled win rate): 38.9%",
    "MT-Bench (overall): 8.97",
    "AlignBench (overall, Chinese): 7.91",
    "Outperforms all open-source and most closed-source models on AlignBench"
], top=1.5, width=12.0, size=19)

# Slide 9
s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6]); set_bg(s)
add_title(s, "Key Takeaways")
add_bullets(s, [
    "MLA is a high-quality, low-cache attention mechanism (93.3% KV reduction)",
    "DeepSeekMoE enables 236B total scale with only 21B activated parameters",
    "DeepSeek-V2 cuts training cost by 42.5% vs. DeepSeek 67B",
    "Throughput gain of 5.76× improves real-world deployment efficiency",
    "Model sits on a strong cost-performance Pareto frontier among open models"
], top=1.5, width=12.1, size=19)

out='/app/output/final_deck.pptx'
prs.save(out)
print(out)
PY

    t = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(0.6), Inches(0.25), Inches(12.2), Inches(0.9))
    tf = t.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    r = p.add_run()
    r.text = title
    r.font.size = Pt(34)
    r.font.bold = True
    r.font.color.rgb = NAVY
    if subtitle:
        p2 = tf.add_paragraph()
        p2.text = subtitle
        p2.font.size = Pt(16)
        p2.font.color.rgb = GRAY


def add_bullets(slide, items, left=0.8, top=1.4, width=6.2, height=4.8, size=20):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(left), Inches(top), Inches(width), Inches(height))
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.clear()
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = it
        p.level = 0
        p.font.size = Pt(size)
        p.font.color.rgb = NAVY
        p.space_after = Pt(10)
